rationale: Archive Tarana Wireless from the direct-infrastructure PortCo list. Tarana sells fixed-wireless radio equipment, proprietary silicon, cloud software and support to independent broadband operators; the operators, rather than Tarana, own the commercial networks, towers, spectrum and subscriber relationships. I Squared invested through its Global InfraTech growth strategy, and no Tarana-owned qualifying infrastructure platform was verified through August 19, 2026.

supports: Tarana supplies radios, software and support to network operators
Customer operators deploy and own the commercial broadband networks

The investment is associated with a technology growth strategy

beforeImage.name: Tarana Wireless
beforeImage.description: Tarana Wireless develops fixed-wireless broadband equipment designed to improve network economics and performance. Its customers include broadband service providers that deploy access infrastructure to reach homes and businesses in hard-to-serve or capital-constrained markets. The business follows a technology and equipment model centered on radio hardware, software, and service-provider channel relationships rather than ownership of regulated networks. Public materials identify a 2009 founding year and indicate that Tarana’s technology has been deployed by hundreds of operators across dozens of countries and most U.S. states. I Squared participated in Tarana’s March 2022 financing round through its InfraTech strategy; the resulting ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. The investment gives I Squared exposure to broadband-enablement technology complementary to its fiber and digital-infrastructure holdings.

milestones.event: Public materials identify Tarana’s founding year.
The financing announcement stated that the company expected to surpass $100 million in annual revenue.
Tarana announced a $170 million growth financing round that included I Squared Capital.
